terms.label: sodium dihydrogenphosphate monohydrate
description: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of sodium dihydrogenphosphate.

terms.label: magnesium sulfate heptahydrate
description: A hydrate that is the heptahydrate form of magnesium sulfate.

terms.label: sodium dithionite
description: An inorganic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of dithionous acid.

terms.label: cyanocob(III)alamin
description: A complex cob(III)alamin in which cobalt is positioned in the centre of a planar corrin tetrapyrrole ring and bound axially to a 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole moiety and a cyano group. It is one of several forms of the vitamin known as vitamin B12.

terms.label: pyridoxamine hydrochloride
description: A hydrochloride obtained by combining pyridoxamine with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used for treatment of diabetic nephropathy.

terms.label: magnesium sulfate
description: A magnesium salt having sulfate as the counterion.
synonyms: Magnesium sulfate anhydrous component of suprep bowel prep kit

terms.label: sodium citrate dihydrate
description: The dihydrate of trisodium citrate.

terms.label: vitamin B12
description: Any member of a group of cobalamin vitamers that exhibit biological activity against vitamin B<small><sub>12</sub></small> deficiency. Vitamin B<small><sub>12</sub></small> deficiency is associated with low red blood cell count and anemia. The vitamers are found in foods such as cereals, meat, fish, and poultry. The vitamers include adenosylcobalamin, hydroxocobalamin, cyanocobalamin, aquacobalamin, nitritocobalamin and methylcobabalamin (also includes their ionized, salt and phosphate derivatives).

terms.label: L-cysteine hydrochloride
description: A hydrochloride obtained by combining <small>L</small>-cysteine with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride.

terms.label: L-cysteine hydrochloride hydrate
description: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of <small>L</small>-cysteine hydrochloride.

terms.label: EDTA disodium salt (anhydrous)
description: An organic sodium salt that is the anhydrous form of the disodium salt of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA).

terms.label: trimagnesium dicitrate
description: A magnesium salt composed of magnesium and citrate ions in a 3:2 ratio.

terms.label: magnesium dihydroxide
description: A magnesium hydroxide in which the magnesium atom is bound to two hydroxide groups.

terms.label: iron(3+) sulfate
description: A compound of iron and sulfate in which the ratio of iron(3+) to sulfate ions is 3:2.

terms.label: scutellarin
description: The glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of scutellarein.

terms.label: 5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid
description: A formyltetrahydrofolic acid in which the formyl group is located at position 5.

terms.label: tryptophol
description: An indolyl alcohol that is ethanol substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 2.

terms.label: sodium hexanoate
description: An organic sodium salt resulting from the replacement of the proton from the carboxy group of hexanoic acid by a sodium ion.

terms.label: coenzyme M
description: An organosulfonic acid consisting of sulfonic acid having a 2-mercaptoethyl group attached to sulfur.

terms.label: 1-eicosanoyl-2-[(11Z,14Z,17Z)-eicosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
description: A phosphatidylcholine 40:3 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are eicosanoyl and (11Z,14Z,17Z)-eicosatrienoyl respectively.

terms.label: polygalacturonic acid
description: An oligosaccharide of more than twenty <small>D</small>-galacturonic acid residues joined by α(1→4) glycosidic linkages. In the diagram, n > 18.

terms.label: beef (ground)
description: A ground beef product is made of beef that has been finely chopped with a knife or a meat grinder (American English) or mincing machine (British English). Ground beef is used in many recipes including hamburgers and spaghetti Bolognese.
Beef that has been ground.
